verdicts.reason: Both break the invite line into a narrow column of one or two words per line ("THIS / SUMMER / IN / LIVONIA"), and the dates are split into fragments ("JUNE / 8-24"). In both, the cross is blown up and blurry, and the hiker illustration has a hard, cut-off bottom edge. B is worse because the invite column, dates, cross and "WORSHIP" text are jammed against each other with almost no gap. A's bigger gaps make its middle columns read as separate blocks, though the cluster still looks messy.
